main_block: Traditional sets today. Full rest between each set.
[IMF-181 | Dumbbell Shoulder Press, Seated] 3 sets of 10 reps, rest 60 seconds between sets.
[IMF-190 | Machine Lateral Raise] 3 sets of 12 reps, rest 60 seconds between sets.
[IMF-192 | Dumbbell Front Raise] 3 sets of 10 reps, rest 60 seconds between sets.
[IMF-172 | Face Pull] 3 sets of 15 reps, rest 60 seconds between sets.
[IMF-198 | Cuban Press] 2 sets of 12 reps, rest 60 seconds between sets.
[IMF-199 | External Rotation, Cable] 2 sets of 15 reps each side, rest 45 seconds between sets.
Superset 1: complete all sets before moving on
Exercise A: [IMF-186 | Arnold Press] 4 sets of 10 reps, rest 50 seconds after completing both exercises then repeat
Exercise B: [IMF-189 | Cable Lateral Raise] 4 sets of 12 reps each side
Superset 2: complete all sets before moving on
Exercise A: [IMF-190 | Machine Lateral Raise] 3 sets of 15 reps, rest 50 seconds after completing both exercises then repeat
Exercise B: [IMF-193 | Cable Front Raise] 3 sets of 12 reps
Superset 3: complete all sets before moving on
Exercise A: [IMF-172 | Face Pull] 3 sets of 15 reps, rest 50 seconds after completing both exercises then repeat
Exercise B: [IMF-197 | Band Pull-Apart] 3 sets of 15 reps
[IMF-199 | External Rotation, Cable] 2 sets of 15 reps each side, rest 45 seconds between sets

Note: Superset 1 requires a dumbbell station and a cable station at the same time. If both are not available, perform the Arnold Press with dumbbells first, rest 30 seconds, then move to the cable for lateral raises and treat them as traditional sets.

exercises: [IMF-181 | Dumbbell Shoulder Press, Seated] 4 sets of 10 reps, controlled press up and a slow lower back down
[IMF-188 | Dumbbell Lateral Raise] 4 sets of 12 reps, raise to shoulder height and resist the weight on the way down
[IMF-193 | Cable Front Raise] 3 sets of 12 reps, lift to shoulder height and control the descent
[IMF-172 | Face Pull] 3 sets of 15 reps, pull to forehead height and hold briefly at the end of each rep
[IMF-189 | Cable Lateral Raise] 3 sets of 12 reps each side, single arm, keep a slight bend in the elbow throughout
[IMF-199 | External Rotation, Cable] 3 sets of 15 reps each side, slow and controlled through the full range
